## PresenceTimeoutError class

Thrown when a required fresh, per-use human presence action did not happen within the allotted time — the device was present and ready, but no touch, tap, or biometric approval was performed before the timeout elapsed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class PresenceTimeoutError extends VaultError 
```
**Extends:** [VaultError](./vaultkeeper.vaulterror.md)

## Remarks

Distinct from [DeviceNotPresentError](./vaultkeeper.devicenotpresenterror.md) (the device itself was absent) and from [PresenceDeclinedError](./vaultkeeper.presencedeclinederror.md) (the human actively declined). Inspect [PresenceTimeoutError.timeoutMs](./vaultkeeper.presencetimeouterror.timeoutms.md) for how long the operation waited.
